What are the objectives of GCP online training at 3RI Technologies? The objectives of GCP online training is Understanding the terminologies and concepts used in Google Cloud Platform Learning about the different products and services offered by GCP Learning how to develop, deploy and implement a solution in Google cloud Brief about the different cloud service providers 2. What you will learn in this GCP online course? You will be learning the below topics Google cloud introduction Learning to manage and provide solutions in Google cloud Implementing the architecture in Google cloud Services and Products offered by Google Cloud Platform Analyze data in Google cloud Development and Deployment of solutions in Google Cloud Platform Management of GCP services using the Console, App, and Command Line Interface Learning about Machine Learning service that is offered by GCP 3. Who should take this GCP Training? Any professional in IT, System or network admins, Software developers who want to develop and deploy SaaS, IaaS, PaaS services, Project Managers can take up the GCP course. Also, any business owner who is planning to migrate to Google Cloud can take up this GCP training and certification. 4. What are the prerequisites for enrolling in this GCP training online? There is no specific pre-requisite for this GCP online course. However, if the student has some background in IT or prior experience of working in IT, that would be an added advantage. 5. What are the job roles offered to GCP Professionals? You can work as GCP Cloud Developer GCP Cloud Architect GCP Cloud Data Engineer GCP DevOps Engineer GCP Security Engineer GCP Network Engineer There are several job opportunities available for Google Cloud certified professionals. 6. Will I get any certificate after this course? Yes, you will be awarded a GCP training certificate after the successful completion of this course at 3RI Technologies. 7. Will I get assistance for placement after completing this GCP online course? You will get placement assistance once you complete the GCP online course. We have tie-ups with 300+ MNC’s that conduct placement drives for our students. Also, we will help you in creating a Resume that will please all employers. Also, we will have Mock rounds of interviews to prepare you for the possible interview questions. 8. Can I attend any free demo classes for this GCP online course? Yes, we provide a demo class before joining the course. To book a demo class visit us at https://www.3ritechnologies.com/demos/ or call us on 7410073340 9. What type of projects will I be working on during this GCP online course? You will be working on multiple projects that we take directly from industries to help you understand the kind of project you may have to handle once you get working. The project will involve deploying a customized website on GCP which provides the facility of SQL and file storage. The next project will involve designing a website that can respond according to the traffic density. After the completion of these projects, it will add stars to your resume. 10. What is the study material of Google Cloud Platform online training? The study material at 3RI Technologies is well-researched by our dedicated team of experts. This team incorporates the new release changes. Along with this, the curriculum is designed keeping in mind the demand for skills that the companies are looking for. Also, the team is regularly updating this material to keep you updated with the market changes. You will get lifetime access to this material once you enroll in the GCP online course. 11. If I miss any session, then how will I attend that class again? If you miss any session, you may attend the same session with the upcoming batch. Also, you can watch the recordings of the LIVE session that will be available to you for future use. 12. How will I clarify my doubts from the trainer while e-learning? As these are LIVE GCP online courses, we encourage you to ask your doubts during the session itself. This will be helpful to you as well as to the other students. In case, if you are not comfortable you can send your doubts to [email protected] 13. How long will it take to learn GCP? It will take 8 weekends or 6 weeks to complete the GCP training online. 14. What are the Advantages of GCP Certification? As the current and future market trend shows several businesses moving to a cloud platform for better service and security. So is the demand for qualified GCP professionals is on the rise. GCP certification will help you stand out from the rest of your colleagues at work. It becomes easy for companies to select from a group of people who knows GCP in the true sense. GCP online course at 3RI Technologies will help you in preparing you for these exams and also ensure a practical understanding of every concept.
